patch_description: This crossover keeps the fast antipodal spherical-line initializer from the current program, then combines it with the stronger projected soft-extrema/contact-band gradient strategy from the portfolio optimizer. The construction first finds a low-coherence seven-line packing, converts it into fourteen antipodal points, explores broken-symmetry full-space restarts, and applies a high-sharpness exact-ratio contact polish. All selection uses the evaluator’s actual squared-distance ratio, while smooth objectives are used only to propose updates. Fixed RNG seeds preserve reproducibility.
